name: BITEZ - D8 + D9 + THCP 2000MG Gummies - Candy Apple - Limited Edition
description:
A carnival classic, elevated. Our Limited Edition Candy Apple BITEZ deliver crisp, tart green apple coated in rich, glossy caramel sweetness—capturing that iconic fairground flavor in one premium gummy. Each artisanal piece is loaded with a potent 1,000mg blend of Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP. Two exquisitely crafted delights per pack. This exclusive drop won't stick around—once it's gone, the carnival leaves town.

Candy Apple layers crisp Green Apple with sweet Caramel flavor, packing 2,000mg per bag and 1,000mg per gummy. Each gummy features a potent blend of THCP, Delta-9, and Delta-8 for a stacked BITEZ experience.
